thread.title: Georgia reopens oyster harvest in state waters - NewsBreak
thread.title_full: Georgia reopens oyster harvest in state waters - NewsBreak

author: Kyla Chandler
title: Georgia reopens oyster harvest in state waters - NewsBreak
text:
By Kyla Chandler ,
1 days ago
BRUNSWICK, Ga. (WSAV) — Georgia's territorial waters will be reopening Oct. 8 at 6 a.m., said Commissioner Walter Rabon Tuesday.
The Commissioner of Natural Resources has kept the harvest closed from June through September every year since 2008, but this year, it was extended due to the higher temperatures coastwide. This implementation was made to wait for the water temperature to decrease.
“This extended closure ensured that Georgia continued to meet the requirements of the National Shellfish Sanitation Program to protect public health by implementing a Vibrio parahaemolyticus control plan,” said Dominic Guadagnoli, shellfish fishery manager for the Coastal Resources Division.
You can visit the Georgia Department of Natural Resources to see things you should remember and look at when you're buying oysters, clams, or mussels from seafood dealers and markets.
For more information on the oyster harvest closure, contact GA DNR/Coastal Resources Division at 912-264-7218 .
